full.en: Cellulite PRO, 125 g – food supplement with sweetener. Red wine extract helps to reduce cellulitis aspect, garcinia cambogia contributes to reduce fat storage. Ingredients: Tapioca starch, red wine extract (Vitis vinifera L.) (30% polyphenols), forest fruits aroma, beet concentrate (maltodextrin, powder of beetroot (Beta vulgaris)), garcinia cambogia extract (Garcinia gummi-gutta) (60% hydroxycytric acid - HCA), stabiliser: cellulose, sweetener: steviol glycosides from stevia. Using advice: recommended daily dose 5 g (1 scoop) mix into a glass (150 ml) of water and drink. For precise measuring we suggest weighing. Storage: store in a cool and dry place. Keep out of reach of children! Warnings: the recommended daily amount should not be exceeded. The food supplement is not a substitute for a balanced, varied diet and a healthy lifestyle. Not recommended to use during pregnancy and lactation. If you have diabetes or are taking glucose-lowering medications, or anticoagulant medications, consult your doctor before use.
